Focus
Currently computer vision and reinforcement learning, with an interest in all areas of AI development.

I work where perception, decision-making and language models meet: systems that reconstruct scenes from photographs, learn policies from reward, and generate content from prompts.

Core stack is Python, Java and web technologies, with TensorFlow, scikit-learn, OpenCV, Pandas and NumPy for model development and data work. Project experience spans generative AI, large language models and full-stack AI systems.

I turn research-grade methods into working systems for accessibility, automation and decision-making, and I am working towards a professional career as an Artificial Intelligence Engineer.

Projects

3D Reconstruction using Structure from Motion

A Structure-from-Motion pipeline in Python and OpenCV that reconstructs a complete 3D structure from whatever overlapping photographs it is given. Pick a stage to see what it does.

  • Python
  • OpenCV
  • SIFT
  • FLANN
  • Camera calibration
View the calibration code

Photos of a chessboard give the camera matrix and the lens distortion, so every pixel can be turned into a real viewing direction.

SIFT finds keypoints that stay recognisable when the view changes in scale or rotation, in every photograph.

FLANN links the same physical points across overlapping photographs, and the bad matches are filtered out.

Matched points from many views become a 3D point cloud, with the camera positions recovered along the way.

Reinforcement Learning Agent for CliffBoxPushing

A reinforcement learning agent that learns a reward-maximising policy in the CliffBoxPushing grid-world.

  • Reinforcement learning
  • Policy learning

Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in LLMs

A team study of catastrophic forgetting, where a fine-tuned language model loses what it knew before. We used vulnerability-guided KL anchoring to limit drift from the base model, and evaluated google/gemma-3-1b-it on multiple benchmarks.

  • LLMs
  • KL anchoring
  • gemma-3-1b-it

Sign Language Translation

Converts spoken language into text and generates matching sign language visuals, combining speech recognition, natural language processing and image generation in one workflow.

  • Speech recognition
